title: eugenia neoriedeliana
intro: Eugenia neoriedeliana, commonly known as the "Brazilian guava", is a plant species in the family Myrtaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Eugenia neoriedeliana include its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiproliferative effects against certain types of cancer cells. The bioactive constituents of Eugenia neoriedeliana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
